title: 0.2 Task-aware Otto, in page
description: The model knows which guided task is running, where the visitor is in it, and what the app is busy with, within one page session. Nothing new is stored.

title: 0.3 Task continuity
description: A guided task survives a reload in the same tab, as D-20 decides.

title: 0.4 Desktop companion shell
description: Otto runs as a normal desktop application: a taskbar entry, minimise, maximise, restore and close, no permanent always-on-top, and a compact mode beside the full window.

title: 0.5 Window management
description: Otto lists, focuses, moves, resizes, minimises, maximises, restores and closes other windows and switches workspaces by voice, and checks every result against a fresh observation.

title: 0.6 Personal memory
description: Otto remembers what the desktop owner tells him across restarts, recalls it when asked, and shows and forgets it on request.

title: 0.7 Extensions and MCP
description: Skills and MCP servers add tools to Otto through the existing tool gateway and policy, without changing the orchestrator.

title: 0.8 Hand pointer and roaming
description: Hand control moves a pointer and drags windows through the checked desktop actions, and Otto walks along window edges.
